description: Ten-T Comprehensive Road Network is a dataset listed in Malta Inspire Geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by haleconnect.com. The TEN-T policy supports the completion of 30 Priority Projects, alongside projects of common interest and traffic management systems that will support the movement of goods and passengers within the EU.The comprehensive network constitutes the basic layer of the TEN-T. Coverage: MT. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2024-08-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-mita.
